a: Rav hamenuna ori becharta deargez bishne derav chisda.
Ravina sar sakkina bevavel. amar leh rav ashe: may tama avad mar hachi?
Amar leh: veha rav hamenuna ori becharta deargez bishne derav chisda! amar leh: "lav ori" ittemar.
Amar leh: ittemar "ori", veittemar "la ori", bishne derav huna rabbeh hu dela ori, veori bishne derav chisda, detalmid chaver dileh hava. vaana name talmid chaver demar ana.
Amar rava: tzureba merabbanan chaze lenafsheh. ravina ikkela lemachoza, ayyti ushepizchaneh sakkina veka machve leh. amar leh: zil amteyeh lerava.
Amar leh: la savar mar ha deamar rava tzureba merabbanan chaze lenafsheh. amar leh: ana mizban zavena.
(Siman: zila lehaneya, machlif, ika, veyaakov).

Rabbi elazar mehageronya verav abba bar tachlifa ikkelau leve rav acha bereh derav ika, beatreh derav acha bar yaakov. bae rav acha bereh derav ika lemibad lehu igla tilta, ayyti sakkina veka machve lehu.
Amar lehu rav acha bar tachlifa: la lechush leh lesava? amar lehu rabbi elazar mehageronya: hachi amar rava, tzureba merabbanan chaze lenafsheh. chazi, veianish rabbi elazar mehageronya.
Vehaamar rava: tzureba merabbanan chaze lenafsheh! shane hatam deatchilu bichvodo.
Vei baet ema: shane rav acha bar yaakov demufelag.

Amar rava: uleafroshe meissura — afillu befanav shappir dame. ravina hava yatev kammeh derav ashe, chazyeh lehahu gavra deka asar leh lechamreh betzinta beshabbeta. rema beh kala, vela ashgach beh. amar leh: leheve hay gavra beshamta.
Amar leh: ki hay gavvna, mi mitchaze keafkeruta? amar leh: "en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged Adonai", kol makom sheyyesh bo chillul hashshem — en cholkin kavod larav.
Amar rava: befanav — asur, vechayyayv mita. shello befanav — asur, veen chayyayv mita.

Veshello befanav la? veha tanya: rabbi eliezer omer: lo metu bene aharon ad shehoru halacha bifne moshe rabban. may derush: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach", amru: af al pi shehaesh yoredet min hashshamayim, mitzva lehavi min hahedyot.
Vetalmid echad haya lo lerabbi eliezer, shehora halacha befanav. amar rabbi eliezer leimma shalom ishto: tameah ani im yotzi ze shenato. velo hotzi shenato.
Amra lo: navi atta? amar lah: lo navi anochi velo ben navi anochi, ella kach mekkubbelani: kol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyayv mita.
Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: oto talmid yehuda ben gureya shemo, vehaya rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot?!
Befanav hava. veha rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot kaamar! velitamaych: shemo veshem aviv lamma? ella shello tomar mashal haya.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammore halacha bifne rabbo, rauy lehakkisho nachash, shenneemar: "vayyaan elihu ven barachel habbuzi vayyomar tzair ani leyamim vegomer al ken zachalti". uchetiv: "im chamat zochale afar".
Zeeri amar rabbi chanina: nikra chote, shenneemar: "belibbi tzafanti imratecha lemaan lo echeta lach".
Rav hamenuna rame: ketiv "belibbi tzafanti imratecha", uchetiv "bissarti tzedek bekahal rav"! la kashya: kan — bizman sheira hayyairi kayyaym, kan — bizman sheen ira hayyairi kayyaym.

Amar rabbi abba bar zavda: kol hannoten mattenotav lechohen echad, mevi raav leolam, shenneemar "ira hayyairi haya chohen ledavid". ledavid hu dahava kohen, lechulle alma la?! ella shehaya meshagger lo mattenotav, uchetiv batreh: "vayhi raav bime david".
Rabbi eliezer omer: moridin oto miggedullato, shenneemar: "vayyomer elazar hakkohen el anshe hatztzava vegomer". af al gav daamar lehu: laachi abba tzivva, veoti lo tzivva — afillu hachi, ianash.
Dichtiv: "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod", vela ashkechan deitzterich leh yehoshua.
Amar rabbi levi: kol demotev milla kammeh rabbeh — azel lishol belo valad, shenneemar: "vayyaan yehoshua bin nun mesharet moshe mibbechurav vayyomar adoni moshe kelaem".
b: Uchetiv: "non beno yehoshua beno".
Ufeliga derabbi abba bar pappa, deamar rabbi abba bar pappa: lo neenash yehoshua ella bishvil shebbittel et yisrael layla achat mipperiyya ureviyya.
Shenneemar: "vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyomer (lo) ki ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati vegomer".
Amar lo: emesh bittaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim, veachshav bittaltem talmud tora. al eze mehen bata? amar lo: "atta bati".
Miyyad: "vayyelech yehoshua ballayla hahu betoch haemek", veamar rabbi yochanan: melammed shehalach beomkah shel halacha.
Ugemiri dechol zeman shearon ushechina sheruyin shello bimkoman asurin betashmish hammitta.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: gadol talmud tora yoter mehakeravat temidin, daamar leh: "atta bati".
Amar rav berona amar rav: kol hayyashen bekila sheish veishto sheruyin bah, — alav hakkatuv omer: "neshe ammi tegarshun mibbet taanugeha".
Veamar rav yosef: afillu beishto nidda.
Rava amar: im ishto nidda hi — tavo alav beracha. vela hi, dead haiddana man natreh?
Hahu mevoa dahava dayayr bah lachman bar ristak. amaru leh: ogar lan reshutach, la ogar lehu.
Ato amaru leh leabbaye. amar lehu: zilu battilu reshutayychu legabbe chad, have leh yachid bimkom goy, veyachid bimkom goy la asar.
Amaru leh: midde hu tama ella dela shechiach dedayyri, vehacha ha kadayyri!
Amar lehu: kol battole reshutayyhu gabbe chad, milleta dela shechicha hi, umilleta dela shechicha, la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Azal rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amra lishmata kammeh derava, amar leh:

a: Im ken, bittalta torat eruv meoto mavoy!
Dimarvi. yomru eruv moil bimkom goy?! demachrezinan.
Achrazta ledardeke?!

Ella amar rava: lezil chad minnayyhu, likrav leh, velishol minneh ducheta velaynnach beh midde, dehave leh kischiro ulekito, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: afillu sechiro vaafillu lekito — noten eruvo vedayyo.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hayu sham chamishsha sechiro vachamishsha lekito mahu? amar leh: im amru sechiro ulekito lehakel, yomru sechiro ulekito lehachamir?
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: afillu sechiro vaafillu lekito, noten eruvo vedayyo. amar rav nachman: kamma mealleya ha shemata.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shata reviit yayin — al yore. amar rav nachman: la mealleya ha shemata, deha ana kol kamma dela shatena revieta dechamra — la tzila datay.
Amar leh rava: may tama amar mar hachi? haamar rabbi acha bar chanina: may dichtiv "veroe zonot yeabbed hon" — kol haomer shemua zo naa, vezo enah naa — meabbed hona shel tora! amar leh: hadari bi.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: shatuy al yitpallel, veim hitpallel — tefillato tefilla. shikkor al yitpallel, veim hitpallel — tefillato toeva.

Hechi dame shatuy, vehechi dame shikkor? ki ha derabbi abba bar shumeni verav menashsheya bar yirmeya miggifti havo ka mippatri mehadade ammabara dinhar yofti. amaru: kol chad minnan lema milleta dela shemia lechavreh, deamar mari bar rav huna: la yippater adam mechavero ella mittoch devar halacha, shemmittoch kach zochro.
Petach chad vaamar: hechi dame shatuy, vehechi dame shikkor? shatuy — kol sheyyachol ledabber lifne hammelech. shikkor — kol sheeno yachol ledabber lifne hammelech.
Petach iddach vaamar: hammachazik benichse hagger, ma yaase veyitkayyeymu beyado? yikkach bahen sefer tora. amar rav sheshet: afillu
b: Baal benichse ishto.
Rava amar: afillu avad iska urevavch. rav pappa amar: afillu matza metzia. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: afillu ketav behu tefillin.
Veamar rav chanin, veittema rabbi chanina: may keraa, dichtiv: "vayyiddar yisrael neder vegomer".

Amar rame bar abba: derech mil, veshena kol shehu — mefigin et hayyayin. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella sheshshata kede reviit, aval shata yoter merviit — kol shekken shedderech toradto veshena meshakkarto.

Vederech mil mefiga hayyayin?! vehatanya: maase berabban gamliel shehaya rochev al hachamor vehaya mehallech meakko lichziv, vehaya rabbi ilay mehallech acharav. matza gelusekin badderech, amar lo: ilay, tol gelusekin min hadderech. matza goy echad, amar lo: mavgay, tol gelusekin hallalu meilay.
Nittappel lo rabbi ilay, amar lo: mehechan atta? amar lo: meayayrot shel bureganin. uma shimcha? mavgay shemeni. kelum hikkircha rabban gamliel meolam? amar lo: lav.
Beotah shaa lamadnu shekkivvevn rabban gamliel beruach hakkodesh. ushelosha devarim lamadnu beotah shaa: lamadnu sheen maavirin al haochalin.
Velamadnu sheholchin achare rov ovre derachim. velamadnu shechametzo shel goy achar happesach muttar bahanaa.
Kevan shehiggia lichziv, ba echad lishshael al nidro. amar laze sheimmo: kelum shatinu reviit yayin haitalki? amar lo: hen. im ken, yetayyel acharenu ad sheyyafig yenenu.
Vetiyyel acharehen shelosha milin, ad shehiggia lesullama shel tzur. kevan shehiggia lesullama detzor, yarad rabban gamliel min hachamor, venitattef, veyashav, vehittir lo nidro.

Veharebe devarim lamadnu beotah shaa. lamadnu sherviit yayin haitalki meshakker, velamadnu shikkor al yore, velamadnu shedderech mefiga et hayyayin, velamadnu sheen mefirin nedarim lo rachuv velo mehallech velo omed, ella yoshev.
Katane mihat shelosha milin! shane yayin haitalki dimshakkar tefe.
Vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella sheshshata reviit, aval shata yoter merviit, kol shekken derech toradto veshena meshakkarto!
Rachuv shane. hasheta deatet lehachi, lerami bar abba name la kashya: rachuv shane.
Ini?! vehaamar rav nachman: mefirin nedarim ben mehallech ben omed uven rachuv!
Tannae hi. deikka leman deamar: potchin bacharata.
Veikka leman deamar: en potchin bacharata.

Deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may patach leh rabban gamliel lehahu gavra: "yesh bote kemadkerot charev uleshon chachamim marpe" — kol habbote rauy ledokro becherev, ella shelleshon chachamim marpe.

Amar mar: veen maavirin al haochalin. amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: lo shanu ella bedorot harishonim, sheen benot yisrael perutzot bichshafim. aval bedorot haacharonim, shebbenot yisrael perutzot bichshafim — maavirin.
Tana: shelemin maavirin, petitin en maavirin. amar leh rav assi lerav ashe: veappetitin la avdan? vehachtiv: "vattechallelna oti el ammi beshaale seorim uviftote lechem"! deshakli beagrayyhu.
Amar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya:

a: Yachol ani liftor et kol haolam kullo min haddin miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash vead achshav, shenneemar: "lachen shimi na zot aniyyay ushechurat velo miyyayin".

Metivi: shikkor mikkacho mikkach, umimkaro mimkar. avar avera sheyyesh bah mita — memitin oto, malkot — malkin oto. kelalo shel davar: hare hu kefikkeach lechol devarav, ella sheppatur min hattefilla.
May "yacholni liftor" dekaamar name — middin tefilla.
Amar rabbi chanina: lo shanu ella shello higgia leshichruto shel lot, aval higgia leshichruto shel lot — patur mikkullam.
Amar rabbi chanina: kol hammefik magen bishat gaava, sogrin vechotmin tzarot baado, shenneemar: "gaava afike maginnim sagur chotam tzar".
May mashma dehay "afik" lishshana deabbore hu? dichtiv: "achay bagdu chemo nachal kaafik nechalim yaavoru".
Rabbi yochanan amar: "kol sheeno mefik" ittemar.
May mashma dehay "mefik" lishshana degalloye hu? dichtiv: "vayyerau afike mayim vayyiggalu mosdot tevel".
Mikkede, kerae mashma ben lemar uven lemar, may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu derav sheshet. derav sheshet masar shinteh leshammaeh. mar it leh derav sheshet, umar let leh derav sheshet.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: kol sheen dato meyushshevet alav al yitpallel, mishshum shenneemar: "betzar al yore". rabbi chanina beyoma deratach la metzalle, amar: "betzar al yore" ketiv. mar ukeva beyoma deshuta la hava nafek leve dina.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hilcheta baaya tzilluta keyoma deistana. amar abbaye: i amra li em karev kuttacha — la tenay.
Amar rava: i keratztan kinna la tenay. mar bereh deravina avada leh immeh shiva mane leshiva yome.
Amar rav yehuda: la ibberi lelya ella leshinta. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: la ibberi sehara ella legirsa. amri leh lerabbi zera: mechaddedan shematach. amar lehu: dimame ninhu.
Amara leh barteh derav chisda lerav chisda: la bae mar menam pureta? amar la: hasheta atu yome daariche vekattine, venenum tuva.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: anan poale dimame anan. rav acha bar yaakov yazef ufara.
Amar rabbi elazar: habba min hadderech, al yitpallel shelosha yamim, shenneemar: "vaekbetzem el hannahar habba el achava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina baam vegomer".
Avu dishmuel, ki ate beorcha, la metzalle telata yome. shemuel la metzalle beveta deit beh shichra. rav pappa la metzalle beveta deit beh haresana.
Amar rabbi chanina: kol hammitpatte beyeno — yesh bo middaat kono, shenneemar: "vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach vegomer".
Amar rabbi chiyyay: kol hammityayshshev beyeno — yesh bo daat shivim zekenim. "yayin" nittan beshivim otiyyot, vesod" nittan beshivim otiyyot. nichnas yayin — yatza sod.
Amar rabbi chanin: lo nivra yayin ella lenachem avelim uleshallem sachar larshaim, shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved vegomer".

Amar rabbi chanin bar pappa: kol sheen yayin nishpach betoch beto kammayim — eno bichlal beracha, shenneemar: "uverach et lachmecha veet memecha". ma lechem shennikkach bechesef maaser — af mayim shennikkach bechesef maaser, umay nihu — yayin, veka kare leh mayim.
b: I nishpach beveto kammayim — ikka beracha, vei la — la.
Amar rabbi ilay, bishlosha devarim adam nikkar: bechoso, uvechiso uvechaso. veamri leh af besachako.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yisrael vegoy bappenimit, veyisrael bachitzona. ba maase lifne rabbi, veasar, velifne rabbi chiyyay, veasar.
Yetuv rabba verav yosef beshilhe pirkeh derav sheshet, veyatev rav sheshet vekaamar: keman amra rav lishmateh, kerabbi meir. karkesh rabba resheh.
Amar rav yosef: tere gavre ravreve kerabbanan lito behay milleta? i kerabbi meir, lema li yisrael bachitzona?
Vechi tema, maase shehaya kach haya, veha beo minneh merav: penimi bimkomo mahu? veamar lahen: muttar.
Veella may, kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov? haamar: ad sheyyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze!
Ella kerabbi akiva, deamar: regel hammutteret bimkomah — oseret shello bimkomah.
Lema li goy? afillu yisrael name!
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: leolam kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ucherabbi akiva, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon sheervu, vetama deikka goy daasir, aval lekka goy la asir.

Bea minneh rabbi eliezer merav: yisrael vegoy bachitzona veyisrael bappenimit mahu? hatam tama mishshum dishchiach dedayayr, demirtat goy, vesavar: hasheta ate yisrael veamar li: yisrael dahava gabbach hecha?
Aval hacha, amena leh: nefak azal leh.
O dilma, hacha name mirtat, desavar: hasheta ate yisrael vechaze li.
Amar leh: "ten lechacham veyechkam od".
Resh lakish vetalmide derabbi chanina ikkelau lehahu punedak, vela hava socher, vahava maskir.
Amaru: mahu lemegar minneh? kol hecha dela matze mesallek leh — la tibbee lach dela agrina. ki tibbee — hecha dematze mesallek leh.
May? kevan dematze mesallek — agrina. o dilma, hasheta miha ha la sallekeh?
Amar lahen resh lakish: niskor, velichshennaggia etzel rabbotenu shebbaddarom, nishal lahen. ato shayyayllu lerabbi appas, amar lahen: yafe asitem shessechartem.

Rabbi chanina bar yosef verabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi assi ikkelau lehahu punedak daata goy mare defunedak beshabbeta. amaru: mahu lemegar minneh? socher kimarev dame — ma mearev mibbeod yom, af socher mibbeod yom.
O dilma socher kimvattel reshut dame, ma mevattel reshut vaafillu beshabbat, af socher vaafillu beshabbat?
Rabbi chanina bar yosef amar: niskor, verabbi assi amar: lo niskor, amar lehu rabbi chiyyay bar abba: nismoch al divre zaken veniskor. ato shayyaylu leh lerabbi yochanan, amar lahen:

a: Yafe asitem shessechartem. tahu bah nehardae: umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: socher kimarev dame. may lav: ma mearev mibbeod yom, af socher mibbeod yom!
La, ma mearev vaafillu befachot mishshave peruta, af socher befachot mishshave peruta. uma mearev afillu sechiro ulekito, af socher afillu sechiro ulekito.
Uma mearev chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat — echad mearev al yede kullan, socher name, chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat — echad socher al yede kullan.
Tahe ba rabbi elazar. amar rabbi zera: may tihyay derabbi elazar? amar rav sheshet: gavra rabba kerabbi zera la yada may tihyay derabbi elazar? ka kashya leh dishmuel rabbeh.
Deamar shemuel: kol makom sheosrin umearvin — mevattelin. mearvin veen osrin, osrin veen mearvin — en mevattelin.
Kol makom sheosrin umearvin — mevattelin, kegon shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo.
Mearvin veen osrin — en mevattelin, kegon shete chatzerot ufetach echad benehen.
Osrin veen mearvin — en mevattelin. leetoye may, lav leetoye goy?
Vei daata meetmol — logar meetmol!
b: Ella lav, daata beshabbeta, vekatane: osrin veen mearvin, en mevattelin. shema minna.
Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata. amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart nihalan, deamar shemuel: en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer.
Veen bittul reshut bechureba.
Vaamart lan ala: ki amar shemuel en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer, la amaran ella shete chatzerot ufetach echad benehen. aval zo lifnim mizzo, mittoch sheosrin ze al ze — mevattelin.
Amar leh: ana amena mishshemeh dishmuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: en lanu beeruvin ella kilshon mishnatenu — "anshe chatzer", velo anshe chatzerot!
Amar leh: ki amart lan en lanu beeruvin ella kilshon mishnatenu — aha amart lan: shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim.
Gufa, amar shemuel: en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer, veen bittul reshut bechureba. verabbi yochanan amar: yesh bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer, veyesh bittul reshut bechureba.

Utzericha, dei ashmeinan mechatzer lechatzer, beha kaamar shemuel, mishshum deha tashmishta lechud veha tashmishta lechud. aval chureba, detashmishta chada letarvavyyhu. ema: mode leh lerabbi yochanan.
Vechi ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval behach mode leh lishmuel, tzericha.
Amar abbaye: ha deamar shemuel en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer, la amaran ella bishte chatzerot ufetach echad benehen, aval shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, mittoch sheosrin — mevattelin.

Rava amar: afillu shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, peamim mevattelin ufeamim en mevattelin. ketzad? natnu eruvan bachitzona veshachach echad, ben min happenimit uven min hachitzona, velo erav — shetehen asurot.
Natnu eruvan bappenimit, veshachach echad min happenimit velo erav — shetehen asurot.
Shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav — penimit mutteret vechitzona asura.

Natnu eruvan bachitzona veshachach echad, ben min happenimit uven min hachitzona, velo erav — shetehen asurot. hay bar penimit, leman nivattel? livattel livne fenimit — leta leeruvayyhu gabbayyhu. livattel livne chitzona — en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer!
Hay bar chitzona leman nevattel, livattel livne chitzona — ikka penimit deasra alayyhu. livattel livne penimit — en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer.

Natnu eruvan bappenimit, veshachach echad min happenimit velo erav — shetehen asurot. hay bar penimit leman nevattel? livattel livne happenimit — ikka chitzona deasra alayyhu. livattel livne chitzona — en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer.

a: Shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav — vadday penimit mutteret, deachada dashsha, umishtammesha, vechitzona asura.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: vechi shachach echad min happenimit velo erav ammay shetehen asurot, levattel bar penimit livne penimit, vetete chitzona vetishtere bahadayyhu!
Keman — kerabbi eliezer, deamar: eno tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad? ki kaamena lerabbanan, deamri: tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad!
Rav chisda verav sheshet ki pagi bahade hadade — rav chisda miratan sifvoteh mimmatneyayta derav sheshet, verav sheshet mirta kulleh gufeh mippilpuleh derav chisda.
Bea minneh rav chisda merav sheshet: shene vattim mishshene tzidde reshut harabbim uvau goyim vehikkifum mechitza beshabbat, mahu?

Allibba deman deamar en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer, la tibbee lach. hasheta dei bau learove meetmol matzu mearvi — amrat "en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer", hacha dei bau learove meetmol la matzu mearvi — lo kol shekken?!

Ki tibbee lach allibba deman deamar "yesh bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer". hatam, dei bau learove meetmol matzu mearvi — battole name matze mevattel — aval hacha, dela matzu mearvi meetmol — battole name la matze mevattel.
O dilma la shena. amar leh: en mevattelin.
Met goy beshabbat mahu?
Allibba deman deamar sochrin — la tibbee lach: hasheta tarte avdinan, chada mibbaya!
Ella ki tibbee lach allibba deman deamar en sochrin. tarte hu dela avdinan, ha chada — avdinan, o dilma la shena. amar leh: ani omer mevattelin, vehamenuna amar en mevattelin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: goy sheyyesh lo petach arbaa al arbaa patuach levika, afillu machnis umotzi gemallim ukeronot kol hayyom kullo derech mavoy, en oser al bene mavoy.
May tama? befitcha dimyachad leh, behahu nicha leh.
Ibbaya lehu: patuach lekarpef, mahu? amar rav nachman bar amme mishshemeh deulefana:
b: Afillu patuach lekarpef.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: goy bet satayim — oser, yoter mibbet satayim — eno oser.
Veyisrael bet satayim — eno oser.
Yoter mibbet satayim — oser.
Bea minneh rava bar chaklay merav huna: patuach lekarpef mahu? amar leh: hare amru bet satayim — oser, yoter mibbet satayim — eno oser.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: karpef yoter mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira, vaafillu kor vaafillu korayim — hazzorek letocho chayyayv. may tama, mechitza hi, ella shemchusseret dayorin.
Metiv rav huna bar chinnana: sela shebbayyam gavoah asara verochav arbaa — en metaltelin lo min tocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho. pachot mikkan — metaltelin. ad kamma — ad bet satayim.
Aheyay? illema assefa — bet satayim, tefe la? veha mikkarmelit lecharmelit ka metaltel.

Ella lav aresha, vehachi kaamar: sela shebbayyam gavoah asara verochav arbaa — en metaltelin lo mittocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho. vead kamma — ad bet satayim, ha yater mibbet satayim — metaltelin. alma karmelit hi, teyuveta derabbi yochanan!
Amar rava: man dela yada tarotze matneyayta — teyuveta motev leh lerabbi yochanan. leolam aresha, vehachi kaamar: ha betocho — metaltelin. vead kamma — ad bet satayim.
Rav ashe amar: leolam aresha, hen amru vehen amru.
Hen amru: karpef yater mibbet satayim shello hukkaf ledira — en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot. vehen amru: en metaltelin mershut hayyachid lecharmelit.
Bet satayim deshare letaltole bechulleh, asri rabbanan letaltole lo min hayyam letocho velo mittocho layyam. may tama, reshut hayyachid gemura hi.
Yater mibbet satayim, deasur letaltole bechulleh, sharu rabbanan letaltole mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho. may tama? dilma amri: reshut hayyachid gemura hi, veate letaltole bechulleh.
Umay shena? tocho shechiach. mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho — la shechiach.
Hahu yanoka deishtefich chammimeh. amar lehu rabba: nayyto leh chammime miggo betay. amar leh abbaye: veha la arvinan.
Amar leh: nismoch ashshittuf. amar leh: ha la shattefinan. nemru leh legoy layte leh.

Amar abbaye: beay leotoveh lemar, vela shavkan rav yosef, deamar rav [yosef amar rav] kahana: ki havenan be rav yehuda, hava amar lan: bidorayyta — motvinan teyuveta vahadar avdinan maase, bidrabbanan — avdinan maase vahadar motvinan teyuveta.
Levatar hachi amar leh: may baet leotoveh lemar? amar [leh: detanya]: hazzaa shevut, vaamira legoy shevut.

a: Ma hazzaa shevut, veenah docha et hashshabbat. af amira legoy shevut, veenah docha et hashshabbat.
Amar leh: vela shane lach ben shevut deit beh maase lishvut delet beh maase? deha mar la amar legoy: zil achem.

Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: mevoa deit beh tere gavre ravreve kerabbanan, la leheve beh la eruv velo shittuf?! amar leh: may naaved? mar, lav orcheh. ana, teridna begirsay. inhu, la mashgechi.
Vei akni lehu pitta besalla — kevan dei bau la minnay vela efshar litteva nihalayyhu, batel shittuf.
Detanya: echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh yayin vashemen, velo natnu lo — batel hashshittuf.
Venakne lehu mar reviata dechalla bechavita. tanya, en mishtattefin baotzar.
Veha tanya mishtattefin! amar rav oshaya: la kashya, ha — bet shammay, ha — bet hillel.
Ditnan: hammet babbayit, velo petachim harebe — kullan temein.
Niftach echad mehen — hu tame, vechullan tehorin. chishshev lehotzio beechad mehen, o bachallon sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa — matztzil al kol happetachim kullan.
Bet shammay omrim: vehu shechishshev ad shello yamut hammet. uvet hillel omrim: af mishsheyyamut hammet.
Hahu yanoka deishtefuch chammimeh, amar lehu rava: nishayyeyla leimmeh i tzericha — nachem leh goy aggav immeh.
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: immeh ka achla tamre. amar leh: emor, tuneba bealma hu denaket la.
Hahu yanoka deishtefuch chammimeh, amar lehu rava: pannu li mane mibbe gavre leve neshe, veezil veittev hatam veevattel lehu ha chatzer.
Amar leh ravina lerava, vehaamar shemuel: en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer?! amar leh: ana kerabbi yochanan sevira li, deamar: yesh bittul mechatzer lechatzer.
Vei la savar la mar kishmuel
b: Nittev mar beducheteh, venivattel lehu ledidhu, venihderu inhu venivattelu leh lemar, deha amar rav: mevattelin, vechozrin umevattelin.
Ana beha kishmuel sevira li, deamar: en mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin.

Velav chad tama hu? may tama en mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin — lav mishshum dechevan devatteleh lirshuteh, istallak leh mehacha ligmare, vehave leh keven chatzer acheret, veen bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer. mar name, la nivattel.
Hatam hayeynu tama: ki hechi dela leheve milleta derabbanan kechucha veitlula.
Gufa, rav amar: mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin, ushemuel amar: en mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin.
Lema rav ushemuel biflugeta derabbanan verabbi eliezer ka mippalgi.
Derav deamar kerabbanan ushemuel deamar kerabbi eliezer.

Amar lecha rav, ana daamari afillu lerabbi eliezer: ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam hammevattel reshut chatzero — reshut beto bittel, mishshum divvayit bela chatzer la dayyri inashe. aval leinyan istalloke, mi amar?
Ushemuel amar: ana daamari afillu kerabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella may devattel battel, udela battel la battel. aval may devattel — miha istallak ligmare.
Amar rav acha bar chana amar rav sheshet, ketannae: mi shennatan reshuto, vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bemezid — oser, beshogeg — eno oser.
May lav, beha kamippalgi: demar savar mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin, umar savar en mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin.

Amar rav acha bar tachlifa mishshemeh derava: la, dechulle alma en mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin, vehacha bekansu shogeg attu mezid ka mippalgi. mar savar: kansu shogeg attu mezid, umar savar: lo kansu shogeg attu mezid.
Rav ashe amar: rav ushemuel biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbanan ka mippalgi.
Amar rabban gamliel: maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu. tzadduki man dechar shemeh?

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: tzadduki hare hu kegoy, verabban gamliel omer: tzadduki eno kegoy. veamar rabban gamliel: maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim, veamar lanu abba: maharu vehotziu et hakkelim lammavoy, ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem.

Vehatanya: haddar im hannochri, tzadduki, uvaytosi — hare ellu osrin alav. (rabban gamliel omer: tzadduki uvaytosi enan osrin.) umaase betzadduki echad shehaya dar im rabban gamliel bemavoy birushalayim, veamar lahem rabban gamliel levanav: banay, maharu vehotziu ma sheattem motziin vehachenisu ma sheattem machnisin, ad shello yotzi hattoev hazze veyeesor alechem, shehare bittel reshuto lachem, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: belashon acheret — maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy, ad shello techshach veyeesor alechem.
Amar mar: hotziu ma sheattem motziin, vehachenisu ma sheattem machnisin, ad shello yotzi hattoev hazze veyeesor alechem. lememra dechi mappeki inhu vahadar mappek ihu la asar?!

a: Vehatnan mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — oser, divre rabbi meir.
Amar rav yosef: ema "eno oser". abbaye amar, la kashya: kan — shehecheziku bene mavoy bammavoy, kan — shello hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy.
Vehatanya: ad shello natan reshuto, hotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid — yachol levattel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg yachol levattel, bemezid eno yachol levattel.

Mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bemezid oser, beshogeg eno oser. bamme devarim amurim — beshello hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy, aval hechziku bene mavoy bammavoy, ben beshogeg uven bemezid — eno oser.
Amar mar: rabbi yehuda omer belashon acheret: maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy ad shello techshach veyeesor alechem. alma goy hu. veha anan "ad shello yotzi" tenan!
Ema "ad shello yotzi hayyom". veibbaet ema, la kashya: kan — bemumar lechallel shabbatot betzina, kan — bemumar lechallel shabbatot befarhesya.
Keman azla ha detanya: mumar vegilluy panim hare ze eno mevattel reshut. gilluy panim — mumar have?
Ella: mumar begilluy panim — eno yachol levattel reshut, keman kerabbi yehuda.
Hahu dinfak bechumarta dimdusha. kevan dechazyeh lerabbi yehuda nesia, kasseyay. amar: kegon ze mevattel reshut lerabbi yehuda.

Amar rav huna: ezehu yisrael mumar — ze hamechallel shabbatot befarhesya. amar leh rav nachman: keman? i kerabbi meir deamar: chashud ledavar echad, — chashud lechol hattora kullah, afillu beechad mikkol issurin shebbattora name.
I kerabbanan, haamri: chashud ledavar echad la have chashud lechol hattora kullah,
b: Ad dehave mumar laavoda zara.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: litten reshut ulevattel reshut. vechidtanya: yisrael mumar, meshammer shabbatto bashshuk — mevattel reshut, sheeno meshammer shabbatto bashshuk — eno mevattel reshut.
Mippene sheamru: yisrael notel reshut venoten reshut. uvegoy, ad sheyyaskir. ketzad? omer lo: reshuti kenuya lach, reshuti mevuttelet lach — kana, veen tzarich lizkot.
Rav ashe amar: hay tanna hu dachamira aleh shabbat kaavoda zara.
Kidtanya: "mikkem" — velo kullechem, perat lammumar. "mikkem" — bachem chillakti, velo baummot.

"Min habbehema" — lehavi bene adam haddomin livhema. mikkan amru: mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael, kede sheyyachzeru bitshuva. chutz min hammumar, vehamenassech yayin, vehamechallel shabbatot befarhesya.

Ha gufa kashya: amrat "mikkem" velo kullechem, lehotzi et hammumar. vahadar tane: mekabbelin korbanot mipposhe yisrael! ha la kashya: resha — bemumar lechol hattora kullah, metziata — bemumar ledavar echad.
Ema sefa: chutz min hammumar vehamenassech yayin. hay mumar, hechi dame? i mumar lechol hattora — hayeynu resha. i ledavar echad, kashya metziata.
Ella lav hachi kaamar: chutz min hammumar lenassech ulechallel shabbatot befarhesya. alma avoda zara veshabbat ki hadade ninhu. shema minna.
Mishna anshe chatzer sheshshachach echad mehen velo erav — beto asur millehachnis umillehotzi lo velahem, veshellahem muttarin lo velahem. natnu lo reshutan — hu muttar, vehen asurin.
Hayu shenayim — osrin ze al ze. sheechad noten reshut venotel reshut, shenayim notnin reshut veen notlin reshut.

Meematay notnin reshut? bet shammay omrim: mibbeod yom. bet hillel omrim: mishshechashecha. mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bemezid oser, beshogeg eno oser.
Gemara beto hu deasur, ha chatzero sharya.

Hechi dame? i devattel, beto ammay asur. i dela battel, chatzero ammay sharya? hacha bemay askinan, kegon shebbittel reshut chatzero, velo bittel reshut beto. veka savri rabbanan: hamevattel reshut chatzero — reshut beto lo bittel, dedayayr inish bevayit bela chatzer.
Veshellahen muttar lo velahen, may tama? dehave oreach legabbayyhu.
Natnu lo reshutan, hu muttar vehen asurin. veneheve inhu legabbeh ki orchin! chad legabbe chamishsha — have oreach, chamishsha legabbe chad — la have oreach.
Shema minna, mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin.
Hachi kaamar: natnu lo reshutan meikkara — hu muttar vehen asurin.
Hayu shenayim osrin ze al ze. peshita? la tzericha, dahadar chad minnayyhu uvattel leh lechavreh. mahu detema lishtere, ka mashma lan dechevan dividdana devattel la hava leh sharyuta behay chatzer.
Sheechad noten reshut. ha tu lema li? i noten — tenena, i notel — tenena?
Sefa itztericha leh: shenayim notnin reshut. ha name peshita! mahu detema

a: Ligzar dilma ate levattole lehu. ka mashma lan.
Veen notlin reshut. lema li? la tzericha, af al gav deamri leh: keni al menat lehakenot.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba: chamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat, veshachach echad mehen velo erav, keshehu mevattel reshuto tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad o la? amar leh: tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad.
Etiveh: echad shello erav noten reshuto leechad sheerav, shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan leechad shello erav, ushenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu, o leechad shello erav.
Aval lo echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav, veen shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu, veen shenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu.
Katane mihat resha: echad shello erav — noten reshuto leechad sheerav. hechi dame? i delekka acharina bahadeh, bahade man erav?
Ella peshita — deikka acharina bahadeh, vekatane: leechad sheerav!
Verabba: hacha bemay askinan, dahava umit.
I dahava umit — ema sefa, aval en echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav. vei dahava umit, ammay la!
Ella peshita deiteh. umiddesefa iteh, resha name iteh.
Midde irya? ha kidita, veha kidita.
Teda, dekatane sefa deresha: ushenayim shello ervu, notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu. lishnayim in! leechad la.
Veabbaye amar: may "lishnayim" — leechad mishshenayim. i hachi litne: leechad sheerav o leechad shello erav. kashya.
Echad shello erav noten reshuto leechad sheerav. leabbaye deiteh, veka mashma lan: deen tzarich levattel reshut lechol echad veechad. lerabba dahava umit, vela gezur zimnin deiteh.
Ushenayim sheervu notnin reshutan leechad shello erav. peshita? mahu detema kevan dela erav — likneseh, ka mashma lan.

Ushenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim sheervu. lerabba — tena sefa legalloye resha, leabbaye — shenayim shello ervu itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ligzar dilma ate levattole lehu. ka mashma lan.
O leechad shello erav. lema li? mahu detema: hane mille — hecha demiktzatan ervu umiktzatan lo ervu. aval hecha dechullan lo ervu — liknesinhu, kede shello tishtakkach torat eruv, ka mashma lan.
Aval en echad sheerav noten reshuto leechad shello erav. leabbaye — tena sefa legalloye resha, lerabba — ayyeyde ditna resha tena name sefa.

Veen shenayim sheervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu. ha tu lema li? la tzericha, devattel leh chad minnayyhu lechavreh. mahu detema: lishtere leh, ka mashma lan: kevan dividdana devattel la havo leh sharyuta beha chatzer — la.
Veen shenayim shello ervu notnin reshutan lishnayim shello ervu. ha tu lema li? la tzericha, deamri: keni al menat lehikkanot.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: yoresh mahu sheyyevattel reshut.
b: Hecha dei bae learove meetmol matze mearev — battole name matze mevattel, aval hay kevan dei bae learove meetmol — la matze mearev, la matze mevattel.
O dilma: yoresh kareh daavu hu?

Amar leh: ani omer mevattel, vehane deve shemuel tanu en mevattel. etiveh: ze hakkelal, kol shemmuttar lemiktzat shabbat — huttar lechol hashshabbat, vechol shennesar lemiktzat shabbat — nesar lechol hashshabbat chutz mimmevattel reshut.
Kol shehuttar lemikketzat shabbat, muttar lechol hashshabbat — kegon erav derech happetach, venistam happetach. erav derech challon, venistam challon.
Ze hakkelal — leetoye mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav.
Kol shennesar lemiktzat shabbat, nesar lechol hashshabbat kullah — kegon shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, vehikkifum goyim mechitza beshabbat.
Ze hakkelal leetoye may? leetoye met goy beshabbat.
Vekatane: chutz mimmevattel reshut. ihu — in, yoresh — la.
Ema: chutz mittorat bittul reshut.
Etiveh: echad mibbene chatzer shemmet, vehinniach reshuto leechad min hashshuk, mibbeod yom — oser, mishshechashecha — eno oser.
Veechad min hashshuk shemmet vehinniach reshuto leechad mibbene chatzer, mibbeod yom — eno oser, mishshechashecha — oser.
Ammay oser? nivattel! may "oser" name dekatane — ad sheyyevattel.
Ta shema: yisrael veger sheruyin bimgura achat, umet ger mibbeod yom,

a: Af al pi shehechezik yisrael acher binchasav — oser. mishshechashecha, af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher — eno oser.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: mibbeod yom — af al pi shehechzik, vela mibbaya ki lo hechzik. adderabba, ki lo hechzik la asar!
Amar rav pappa: ema: af al pi shello hechzik. veha "af al pi shehechzik" katane?
Hachi kaamar: af al pi shello hechzik mibbeod yom ella mishshechashecha, kevan dahava leh lehachezik mibbeod yom — oser. mishshechashecha, af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher — eno oser.
"Af al pi shello hechzik yisrael acher", vela mibbaya ki hechzik?! adderabba, ki hechzik asar!
Amar rav pappa, ema: "af al pi shehechzik". veha "af al pi shello hechzik" katane! hachi kaamar: af al pi shehechzik mishshechashecha, kevan dela hava leh lehachezik mibbeod yom — eno oser.
Katane mihat resha oser, ammay oser? nivattel!
May "oser" dekatane — ad sheyyevattel.
Rabbi yochanan amar: matnitin, manni? — bet shammay hi, deamri: en bittul reshut beshabbat. ditnan: meematay notnin reshut? bet shammay omrim: mibbeod yom, uvet hillel omrim: mishshettechshach.
Amar ulla: may tama devet hillel, naasa keomer "kelach etzel yafot".
Amar abbaye: met goy beshabbat may "kelach etzel yafot" ikka?

Ella hacha beha kamippalgi: bet shammay savri bittul reshut mikne reshuta hu, umikne reshuta beshabbat — asur. uvet hillel savri istalloke reshuta bealma hu, veistalloke reshuta beshabbat — shappir dame.
Mishna baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenav, laze beyayin velaze beyayin — enan tzerichin learev.
Laze beyayin velaze beshemen — tzerichin learev. rabbi shimon omer: echad ze veechad ze, enan tzerichin learev.

Gemara amar rav: uvichli echad. amar rava, dayka name dekatane: laze beyayin velaze beshemen — tzerichin learev. i amrat bishlama: resha bichli echad, vesefa bishne chelim — shappir. ella i amrat: resha bishne chelim, vesefa bishne chelim — ma li yayin vayayin, ma li yayin vashemen?!
Amar leh abbaye: yayin vayayin rauy learev. yayin veshemen en rauy learev.
Rabbi shimon omer, echad ze veechad ze — en tzerichin learev. vaafillu laze beyayin velaze beshemen! amar rabba: hacha bemay askinan bechatzer shebben shene mevoot, verabbi shimon letameh —

Ditnan, amar rabbi shimon: lema haddavar dome, leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim. ervu shetayim hachitzonot im haemtzait — hi mutteret immahen, vehen muttarot immah, ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam katane: shetayim hachitzonot asurot, hacha katane: en tzerichin learev kelal!
May "en tzerichin learev" — shechenim bahade baal habbayit, aval shechenim bahade hadade — tzerichin learev.
b: Verav yosef amar: rabbi shimon verabbanan biflugeta derabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan ka mippalgi. ditnan: shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin, venaga tevul yom beshemen — lo pasal ella shemen bilvad, verabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shenehen chibburin ze laze.
Rabbanan — kerabbanan, verabbi shimon — kerabbi yochanan ben nuri.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben tadday omer: echad ze veechad ze tzerichin learev. vaafillu laze beyayin velaze beyayin?
Amar rabba: ze ba bilgino veshafach, vaze ba bilgino veshafach — kulle alma la peligi dehave eruv.
Ki peligi kegon shellakchu chavit shel yayin beshuttafut, rabbi eliezer ben tadday savar: en berera, verabbanan savri: yesh berera.
Rav yosef amar: rabbi eliezer ben tadday verabbanan besomchin al shittuf bimkom eruv kamippalgi.
Demar savar: en somchin, umar savar: somchin.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi meir. veamar rav berona amar rav: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben tadday. may tama, lav mishshum dechad tama hu?
Amar leh abbaye: vei chad tama, tarte hilcheta lema li?! ha ka mashma lan dela avdinan kitre chumere beeruvin.
May rabbi meir umay rabbanan? detanya: mearvin bachatzerot befat, veim ratzu learev beyayin — en mearvin. mishtattefin bemavoy beyayin, veim ratzu lehishtattef befat — mishtattefin.
Mearvin bachatzerot umishtattefin bemavoy shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot, sheyyomru: avotenu lo ervu, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: o mearvin o mishtattefin.
Peligi ba rabbi nechumi verabba, chad amar: befat dechulle alma la peligi devachada saggi, ki peligi beyayin.

a: Vechad amar: beyayin dechulle alma la peligi devaenan tarte, ki peligi befat.
Metivi: vachachamim omrim o mearvin o mishtattefin. may lav: o mearvin bechatzer befat, o mishtattefin bemavoy beyayin.
Amar rav giddel amar rav, hachi kaamar: o mearvin bechatzer befat — umuttarin kan vechan, o mishtattefin bemavoy befat — umuttarin kan vechan.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi meir. verav huna amar: minhag kerabbi meir. verabbi yochanan amar: nahagu haam kerabbi meir.
Mishna chamishsha chavurot sheshshavtu bitraklin echad, bet shammay omrim: eruv lechol chavura vachavura, uvet hillel omrim: eruv echad lechullan.
Umodim bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim o baaliyyot, shehen tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura.
Gemara amar rav nachman: machloket bimsifas, aval bimchitza asara — divre hakkol eruv lechol chavura vachavura. ikka deamri, amar rav nachman: af bimsifas machloket.

Peligi ba rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi. chad amar: machloket bimchitzot hammaggiot lattikra, aval mechitzot sheen maggiot lattikra — divre hakkol eruv echad lechullan. vechad amar: machloket bimchitzot sheen maggiot lattikra, aval mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra — divre hakkol tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura.
b: Metivi, amar rabbi yehuda hassabbar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra shetztzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura. al ma nechleku — al mechitzot sheen maggiot lattikra, shebbet shammay omrim: eruv lechol chavura vachavura, uvet hillel omrim: eruv echad lechullan.

Leman deamar bimchitzot hammaggiot lattikra machloket — teyuveta, uleman deamar bimchitzot sheen maggiot lattikra machloket — siyyayta. lehach lishshana deamar rav nachman: machloket bimsifas — teyuveta.
Lehach lishshana deamar rav nachman: af bimsifas machloket, lema tihve teyuveta?
Amar lecha rav nachman: peligi bimchitza, vehu haddin bimsifas. vehay deka mippalgi bimchitza — lehodiacha kochan devet hillel.
Veliflegi bimsifas lehodiacha kochan devet shammay! koach dehettera adif.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda hassabbar.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: umodim bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim uvaaliyyot, shetztzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura. may chadarim, umay aliyyot? illema chadarim — chadarim mammash, vaaliyyot — aliyyot mammash, peshita. ella lav: keen chadarim, keen aliyyot. umay nihu — mechitzot hammaggiot lattikra. shema minna.
Tana: bamme devarim amurim, keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher. aval im haya eruvan ba etzlan — divre hakkol eruv echad lechullan.
Keman azla ha detanya: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan, keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher — eruv echad lechullan. keman, kevet hillel.
Veikka deamri: bamme devarim amurim, keshehaya eruv ba etzlan. aval im hayu molichin et eruvan lemakom acher — divre hakkol tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura.
Keman azla ha detanya: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan, keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher — eruv echad lechullan, keman? dela kechad.
Mishna haachin shehayu ochlin al shulchan avihem vishenim bevattehem — tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad. lefichach, im shachach echad mehem velo erav — mevattel et reshuto.
Ematay, bizman shemmolichin eruvan bimkom acher. aval im haya eruv ba etzlan, o sheen immahen dayorin bechatzer — enan tzerichin learev.
Gemara shema minna mekom lina gorem. amar rav yehuda amar rav: bimkabbele feras shanu.

Tanu rabbanan: mi sheyyesh lo bet shaar, achsadra, umirpeset bachatzar chavero — hare ze en oser alav. (et) bet hatteven (veet) bet habbakar bet haetzim uvet haotzarot — hare ze oser alav. rabbi yehuda omer: eno oser ella mekom dira bilvad.
Amar rabbi yehuda: maase beven nappacha shehayu lo chamesh chatzerot beusha, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: eno oser ella bet dira bilvad.
Bet dira salka datach? ella ema: mekom dira.
May mekom dira? rav amar:

a: Mekom pitta, ushemuel amar: mekom lina.
Metivi: haroim, vehakkayyaytzin vehabbureganin veshomre ferot, bizman sheddarkan lalin bair — hare hen keanshe hair. bizman sheddarkan lalin bassade — yesh lahem alpayim lechol ruach!
Hatam anan sahadi dei mamtu lehu rifta hatam, tefe nicha lehu.

Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata. amar leh abbaye: at amart nihalan, veaha amart nihalan: haachin shehayu ochlin al shulchan avihen, vishenim bevattehen — tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad. veamrinan lach: shema minna mekom lina gorem. vaamart lan ala, amar rav yehuda amar rav: bimkabbele feras shanu.
Tanu rabbanan: mi sheyyesh lo chamesh nashim mekabbelot peras mibbaalehen, vachamishsha avadim mekabbelin peras merabbehen — rabbi yehuda ben betira mattir bannashim, veoser baavadim.
Rabbi yehuda ben bava mattir baavadim, veoser bannashim.
Amar rav: may tama derabbi yehuda ben bava, dichtiv: "vedaniyyel bitra malka".
Peshita, ben etzel aviv, kedaamaran. ishsha etzel balah veeved etzel rabbo, pelugeta derabbi yehuda ben betira verabbi yehuda ben bava. talmid etzel rabbo, may?

Ta shema, derav be rabbi chiyyay amar: en anu tzerichin learev, shehare anu somchin al shulechano shel rabbi chiyyay. verabbi chiyyay be rabbi amar: en anu tzerichin learev, shehare anu somchin al shulechano shel rabbi.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan, keshemmolichin et eruvan lemakom acher, eruv echad lechullan, o tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad? amar leh: eruv echad lechullan.
Veha achin, dechi gavu damu, vekatane: tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad! hacha bemay askinan — kegon deikka dayorin bahadayyhu. demiggo dehane asri, hane name asri.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane: ematay? bizman shemmolichin et eruvan bemakom acher, aval im haya eruvan ba etzlam, o sheen dayorin immahen bechatzer — en tzerichin learev, shema minna.

Bea minneh rav chiyyay bar avin merav sheshet: bene ve rav, deachli nahama bevaga, veatu uvayyti beve rav, ki mashchinan lehu techuma, mibbe rav mashchinan lehu o mibbaga mashchinan lehu? amar leh: mashchinan mibbe rav.
Vahare noten et eruvo betoch alpayim amma, veate uvayet beveteh, demashchinan leh techuma meeruveh!
Behahu — anan sahadi, uvehada — anan sahadi. behahu anan sahadi — dei mittedar leh hatam nicha leh, uvahada anan sahadi — dei mayytu lehu rifta leve rav, nicha lehu tefe.
Bae rame bar chama merav chisda: av uveno, harav vetalmido, kerabbim damu o kichidim damu? tzerichin eruv, o en tzerichin eruv? mavoy shellahen nittar belechi vekora, o en nittar belechi vekora?
Amar leh, tenetuha: av uveno, harav vetalmido, bizman sheen immahen dayorin hare hen kichidim, veen tzerichin learev, umavoy shellahen nittar belechi vekora.
Mishna chamesh chatzerot petuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lemavoy, ervu bachatzerot velo nishtattefu bammavoy — muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bemavoy.
b: Veim nishtattefu bammavoy — muttarin kan vechan.
Ervu bachatzerot venishtattefu bammavoy, veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erav — muttarin kan vechan.
Mibbene mavoy velo nishtattef — muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy, shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim.
Gemara manni? rabbi meir hi, deamar: bainan eruv uvainan shittuf.
Ema metziata: "veim nishtattefu bammavoy muttarin kan vechan", atan lerabbanan deamri bachada saggi!
Ha la kashya: veim nishtattefu name kaamar.

Ema sefa: ervu bachatzerot venishtattefu bammavoy, veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erav — muttarim kan vechan. hechi dame? i dela battel, ammay muttarim? ella peshita devattel. ema sefa: shachach echad mibbene mavoy velo nishtattefu — muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy, vei devattel — ammay asurin bammavoy?
Vechi tema kasavar rabbi meir en bittul reshut bemavoy. veha tanya: shehare bittel lachem reshuto, divre rabbi meir.
Ella peshita dela battel. umiddesefa dela battel — resha name dela battel. resha vesefa rabbi meir, metziata rabbanan!
Kulla rabbi meir hi, vetama may amar rabbi meir bainan eruv uvainan shittuf? shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot, vehacha, kevan derubba ervu — la mishtachcha.
Amar rav yehuda: rav la tane "petuchot zo lazo". vechen amar rav kahana: rav la tane "petuchot zo lazo". ikka deamri, rav kahana gufeh la tane "petuchot zo lazo".
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may tama dela tane petuchot zo lazo. kasavar kol shittuf sheen machniso umotzio derech petachim bammavoy — lav shemeh shittuf.
Etiveh: baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenav, laze beyayin velaze beyayin, en tzerichin learev. hatam, deappekeh veayyeyleh.
(Etiveh:) ketzad mishtattefin bammavoy vechulei. hatam name: deappekeh veayyeyleh.

Matkef la rabba bar chanan: ella meatta, hikna lo pat besallo hachi name dela have shittuf?! vechi tema: hachi name, veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: bene chavura shehayu mesubbin vekiddesh alehen hayyom — happat sheal shulchan somchim aleha mishshum eruv, veamri la mishshum shittuf.
Veamar rabba, la peligi: kan bimsubbin babbayit, kan bamsubbin bechatzer.
Ella tama derav, deka savar: en mavoy nittar belechi vekora ad sheyyehu battim vachatzerot petuchim letocho.
Gufa, amar rav: en mavoy nittar belechi vekora

a: Ad sheyyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho. ushemuel amar: afillu bayit echad vechatzer achat. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chureba.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: amar rabbi yochanan afillu bishvil shel keramim? amar leh: la amar rabbi yochanan ella bechureba, dachaze ledira. aval shevil shel keramim, dela chaze ledira — la.

Amar rav huna bar chinnana: veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, ditnan (amar rabbi shimon): echad gaggot veechad karpefot veechad chatzerot — reshut achat hen lechelim sheshshavtu letochan, velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit.
Veamar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon, vehu shello ervu. aval ervu, gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer.

Ushemuel amar: ben ervu uven lo ervu. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi shimon, ben ervu uven lo ervu. alma: la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane devattim lechatzer, hacha name la gazrinan dilma ate leappoke mane dechatzer lechureba.

Yatev rav berona vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rabbi elazar bar be rav: amar shemuel hachi?! amar leh: in, amar leh: achvi li ushepizeh, achvi leh. ata lekammeh dishmuel, amar leh: amar mar hachi? amar leh: in.
Veha mar hu deamar: en lanu beeruvin ella kilshon mishnatenu, shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim. ishtik.
Kabbela minneh, o la kabbela minneh? ta shema, dehahu mevoa dahava dayayr beh ayvut bar ihi, avad leh lichyay, ushera leh shemuel,
b: Ata rav anan shadye. amar: mevoa dedayayrna beh veatena mishshemeh demar shemuel, nete rav anan bar rav nishdeyeh min?! shema minna la kaybla minneh.
Leolam ema lach kaybla minne, vehacha chazzana hu dahava achel nahama beveteh veate bayet beve chenishta.
Veayvut bar ihi savar: mekom pitta garem. ushemuel letameh deamar: makom lina garem.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mavoy shetztziddo echad goy vetziddo echad yisrael — en mearvin oto derech challonot lehattiro derech petachim lammavoy.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: amar rav afillu bechatzer? amar leh: in, dei la amar may?
Hava amena tama derav mishshum dekasavar: en mavoy nittar belechi vekora ad sheyyehu battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho.
Vetarte lema li! tzericha, dei mehahi —

a: Hava amena: dirat goy shemah dira, ka mashma lan dedirat goy lo shemah dira. vei mehacha — hava amena: la yadana battim kamma, ka mashma lan battim teren.
Hasheta deamar rav afillu chatzer, tama derav deka savar asur laasot yachid bimkom goy.
Amar rav yosef: i hachi hayeynu dishmana leh lerabbi tavla deamar: "goy goy" tere zimne, vela yadana may amar.
Mishna shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, erva happenimit velo erva hachitzona — happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura.
Hachitzona velo happenimit — shetehen asurot. erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah — zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah.
Rabbi akiva oser hachitzona, shedderisat haregel osartah. vachachamim omrim: en derisat haregel osartah.
Shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav — happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. min happenimit velo erav — shetehen asurot.
Natnu eruvan bemakom echad veshachach echad, ben min happenimit ben min hachitzona, velo erav — shetehen asurot. veim hayu shel yechidim — enan tzerichin learev.

Gemara ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yannay: zo divre rabbi akiva, deamar: afillu regel hammutteret bimkomah — oseret shello bimkomah. aval chachamim omrim: keshem sheregel hammutteret enah oseret — kach regel haasura enah oseret.
Tenan: erva chitzona velo penimit shetehen asurot. manni? ilema rabbi akiva, may irya regel asura? afillu regel mutteret name. ella lav rabbanan!
Leolam rabbi akiva, velo zo af zo katane.
Tenan: erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah — zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah. tama deerva, ha lo erva — shetehen asurot,

Veha hay tanna deamar: regel hammutteret enah oseret regel haasura oseret, manni ha? illema rabbi akiva hi — afillu regel hammutteret name, ella lav, rabbanan hi. veod: middesefa rabbi akiva, resha lav rabbi akiva.

Kulla rabbi akiva hi, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah — zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah. bamme devarim amurim — sheasta dakka, aval lo asta dakka — chitzona asura, divre rabbi akiva, sherabbi akiva oser et hachitzona, mippene shedderisat haregel oseret. vachachamim omrim: en derisat haregel oseret.
Metiv rav bivi bar abbaye: veim hayu shel yechidim en tzerichin learev. ha shel rabbim tzerichin learev, alma regel hammutteret bimkomah — enah oseret, regel haasura — oseret!

Veod metiv ravina: shachach echad min hachitzona velo erav — happenimit mutteret vechitzona asura. shachach echad min happenimit velo erav — shetehen asurot. tama deshechach, ha la shachach — shetehen muttarot. alma regel hammutteret — enah oseret, regel haasura — oseret.

Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi yannay: shalosh machlokot baddavar: tanna kamma savar: regel hammutteret — enah oseret, regel haasura — oseret. rabbi akiva savar: afillu regel hammutteret oseret. verabbanan batrae savri: keshem sheregel mutteret enah oseret — kach regel haasura enah oseret.
Natnu eruvan bemakom echad veshachach echad ben min happenimit vechulei. may makom echad?
(Siman chitzona atzmah bevet yechidaa ravina dela meshakkach bifnim)
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: chitzona, umay karu lah "makom echad" — makom hameyuchad lishtehen.
b: Tanya name hachi: natnu eruvan bachitzona, veshachach echad, ben min hachitzona uven min happenimit, velo erav — shetehen asurot, natnu eruvan bappenimit, veshachach echad min happenimit velo erav — shetehen asurot. min hachitzona velo erav — shetehen asurot, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: bazo, penimit mutteret vechitzona asura.
Amar leh rabba bar chanan leabbaye: may shena lerabbanan deamri penimit mutteret — mishshum deachada dashsha umishtammesha, lerabbi akiva name: techad dashsha uteshammesh! amar leh: eruv margilah.
Lerabbanan name eruv margilah! deamra: letakkone shaytaftich, vela leauote.
Lerabbi akiva name tema: letakkone shaytaftich vela leauote? deamra la: mevattelinan lach reshuti. verabbanan, en bittul reshut mechatzer lechatzer.
Lema shemuel verabbi yochanan biflugeta derabbanan verabbi akiva ka mippalgi. dishmuel amar kerabbanan, verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi akiva?
Amar lecha shemuel: ana daamari afillu lerabbi akiva. ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hacha, ella bishte chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, deasran ahadade, aval hatam, mi ka asran ahadade?
Verabbi yochanan amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan. ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha, ella deamra la: addimvattelat li, ka asrat illay. aval hatam, mi kaasra ala?
Veim hayu shel yechidim vechulei. amar rav yosef, tane rabbi: hayu shelosha — asurin.

Amar lehu rav bivi: la tetzitu leh, ana amrita nihale, umishshemeh derav adda bar ahava amrita nihale, hoil vaani kore bahen rabbim bachitzona. amar rav yosef: mareh deavraham! "rabbim" berabbi" ichallaf li.
Ushemuel amar: leolam muttarot, ad sheyyehu shenayim bappenimit veechad bachitzona.
Amar rabbi elazar: vegoy hare hu kerabbim. may shena yisrael dela asar, deman deyada — yada, uman dela yada savar: ayrove ayrev, goy name, amrinan: deyada — yada, dela yada savar: agire ogar!
Setam goy, i ita deogar — mifa pae.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: asara battim ze lifnim mizze, penimi noten et eruvo, vedayyo.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chitzon. chitzon bet shaar hu? chitzon shel penimi.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: bet shaar deyachid shemeh bet shaar. umar savar: la shemeh bet shaar.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: shete chatzerot ushelosha battim benehen, ze ba derech ze, venoten eruvo baze. veze ba derech ze, venoten eruvo baze.

a: Ze naase bet shaar laze, veze naase bet shaar laze. emtzai have leh bayit shemmannichin bo eruv, veen tzarich litten et happat.

Badek lehu rachava lerabbanan: shete chatzerot ushene vattim benehem, ze ba derech ze venatan eruvo baze, vaze ba derech ze venatan eruvo baze, kanu eruv o la? mi meshavvet lehu legabbe dehay bayit, ulegabbe dehay bet shaar [ulegabbe dehay bet shaar, ulegabbe dehay bayit]?
Amaru leh: shenehen lo kanu eruv, ma nafshach: i bet shaar meshavvet leh, hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset — eno eruv. i bayit meshavvet leh — ka metaltel levayit dela mearev leh.

Umay shena midderava? deamar rava: amru lo shenayim tze vearev alenu. leechad erav alav mibbeod yom, uleechad erav alav ben hashshemashot. ze sheerav alav mibbeod yom neechal eruvo ben hashshemashot, veze sheerav alav ben hashshemashot neechal eruvo mishshettechshach — shenehem kanu eruv!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam safek yemama safek lelya la minnachra milleta, aval hacha, i dilgabbe dehay bayit, legabbe dehay bayit. i legabbe dehay bet shaar, legabbe dehay name bet shaar.
Haderan alach haddar
Mishna challon shebben shete chatzerot arbaa al arbaa, betoch asara — mearvin shenayim. veim ratzu — mearvin echad.
Pachot mearbaa al arbaa o lemala measara mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad.
Gemara lema tenan setama kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: kol pachot mearbaa kelavud dame.

Afillu tema kerabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel ella leinyan levudin, aval leinyan pitcha afillu rabbanan modu dei ikka arbaa al arbaa — chashiv, vei la — la chashiv.
Pachot mearbaa vechulei. peshita, kevan deamar arbaa al arbaa betoch asara — mimmela ana yadana defachot mearbaa ulemala measara la!
Ha ka mashma lan tama dechulleh lemala measara, aval miktzato betoch asara — mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu — mearvin echad.
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara, kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara — mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu — mearvin echad.
Hasheta kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara amrat "mearvin shenayim veim ratzu mearvin echad", kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara mibbaya?
"Zo veen tzarich lomar zo" katane.
Amar rabbi yochanan: challon agol tzarich sheyyehe behekkefo esrim vearbaa tefachim, ushenayim umashshehu mehen betoch asara, sheim yerabbeennu, nimtza mashshehu betoch asara.
Mikkedi, kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim — yesh bo berochbo tefach, bitresar saggi.
b: Hane mille beiggula, aval beribbua bainan tefe.
Mikkede, kamma merubba yater al heagol — revia, beshitsar saggi!
Hane mille iggula denafek miggo ribbua. aval ribbua denafek miggo iggula, bainan tefe. may tama? mishshum muresha dekarnata.
Mikkede, kol ammeta beribbua — ammeta utere chummeshe baalachsona, beshevsar neche chumesha saggi.
Rabbi yochanan amar ki dayyayne dekesari, veamri la kerabbanan dekesari, deamri: iggula miggo ribbua — riva, ribbua miggo iggula — palga.

Pachot mearbaa al arbaa vechulei. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella challon shebben shete chatzerot, aval challon shebben shene vattim afillu lemala measara name, im ratzu learev — mearvin echad. may tama? beta keman dimle dame.

Etiveh rava lerav nachman: echad li challon shebben shete chatzerot, veechad li challon shebben shene vattim, veechad li challon shebben shete aliyyot, veechad li challon shebben shene gaggin, veechad li challon shebben shene chadarim — kullan arbaa al arbaa betoch asara!
Targuma achatzerot. veha "echad li" katane! targuma aarbaa al arbaa.
Bea minneh rabbi abba merav nachman: lul happatuach min bayit laaliyyay, tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro o en tzarich sullam kavua lehattiro?
Ki amrinan beta keman dimle dame — hane mille min hatztzad, aval baemtza — la, o dilma la shena?

Amar leh: eno tzarich. sevur minna: sullam kavua hu deeno tzarich, ha sullam aray — tzarich. ittemar, amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: echad sullam kavua veechad sullam aray — eno tzarich.
Mishna kotel shebben shete chatzerot, gavoah asara verochav arbaa — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad.
Hayu berosho perot — ellu olin mikkan veochlin, veellu olin mikkan veochlin, uvilvad shello yoridu lemattan.
Nifretza hakkotel, ad eser ammot — mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu mearvin echad, mippene shehu kefetach. yoter mikkan — mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim.
Gemara en bo arbaa may? amar rav: avir shete reshuyot sholetet bo, lo yaziz bo afillu melo nima.

a: Verabbi yochanan amar: ellu maalin mikkan veochlin, veellu maalin mikkan veochlin.
Tenan: ellu olin mikkan veochlin, veellu olin mikkan veochlin. olin — in, maalin — la.
Hachi kaamar: yesh bo arbaa al arbaa, olin — in, maalin — la. en bo arbaa al arbaa — maalin name.
Veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: makom sheen bo arbaa al arbaa — muttar livne reshut harabbim velivne reshut hayyachid lechattef alav, uvilvad shello yachalifu.
Verav let leh derav dimi? i birshuyot deorayyta — hachi name.
Hacha bemay askinan — birshuyot derabbanan. vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora.
Amar rabba (amar) rav huna amar rav nachman: kotel shebben shete chatzerot, tziddo echad gavoah asara tefachim vetziddo echad shave laaretz — notnin oto laze sheshshave laaretz.
Mishshum dehave laze tashmisho benachat velaze tashmisho bekashe. vechol laze benachat velaze bekashe — notnin oto laze shettashmisho benachat.

Amar rav shezvi amar rav nachman: charitz shebben shete chatzerot, tziddo echad amok asara vetziddo echad shave laaretz — notnin oto laze sheshshave laaretz, mishshum dehave leh laze tashmisho benachat velaze tashmisho bekashe vechulei.
Utzerichi. dei ashmeinan kotel, mishshum divguveha mishtammeshi inashe. aval charitz, beumeka la mishtammeshi inashe — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan becharitz, mishshum dela beita tashmishta. aval kotel divita tashmishta — ema la, tzericha.
Ba lemaato, im yesh bemiuto arbaa — muttar lehishtammesh bechol hakkotel kullo. veim lav — en mishtammesh ella keneged hammiut.
Ma nafshach? i ahani miuta — bechulleh kotel lishtammesh. i la ahani — afillu keneged hammiut name la. amar ravina: kegon sheakar chuleya merosho.
Amar rav yechiel: kafa sefel — memaet.
Veammay? davar hannittal beshabbat hu, vedavar hannittal beshabbat eno memaet. la tzericha, dechabbereh beara.
Vechi chabbereh beara, may have? veha tanya: pagga shehitminah beteven, vacharara shehitminah begechalim, im megulla miktzatah — nittelet beshabbat.
Hacha bemay askinan, deit leh ognayim.
Vechi it leh ognayim, may have? vehatnan: hattomen lefet utzenon tachat haggefen, bizman
b: Shemmiktzat alin megullin eno choshesh lo mishshum kilayim, velo mishshum maaser, velo mishshum sheviit, venittalin bashshabbat!
La tzericha, devae mara vachatzina.
Sullam hammitzri eno memaet vehatztzori memaet. hechi dame sullam hammitzri? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sheen lo arbaa chavokim.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may tama desullam hammitzri dela memaet? amar leh: la shemia lach ha deamar rav acha bar adda amar rav hamenuna amar rav: mishshum dehave leh davar shennittal beshabbat, vechol davar shennittal beshabbat — eno memaet.
I hachi, afillu tzori name! hatam kovdo kovo.

Amar abbaye: kotel shebben shete chatzerot gavoah asara tefachim, vehinniach sullam rachav arbaa mikkan vesullam rachav arbaa mikkan, veen ben ze laze shelosha tefachim — memaet. shelosha — eno memaet.
Vela amaran ella dela have kotel arbaa, aval have kotel arbaa — afillu mufelag tuva, name.
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye: bana itzteva al gav itzteva, im yesh baitzteva hattachtona arbaa — memaet. i name en battachtona arbaa, veyesh baelyona arbaa, veen ben ze laze shelosha — memaet.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: sullam sheshshelivotav porchot, im yesh bashsheliva hattachtona arbaa — memaet. i name en bashsheliva hattachtona arbaa veyesh bashsheliva haelyona arbaa, veen ben ze laze shelosha — memaet.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu:

a: Ziz hayyotze min hakkotel arbaa al arbaa, vehinniach alav sullam kol shehu — miato.
Vela amaran ella deotveh aleh, aval otveh bahadeh arvoche arvecheh.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: kotel tisha asar — tzarich ziz echad lehattiro.
Kotel esrim — tzarich shene zizim lehattiro. amar rav chisda: vehu sheheemidan ze shello keneged ze.
Amar rav huna: ammud birshut harabbim, gavoah asara verachav arbaa, venaatz bo yated kol shehu — miato.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: uvegavoah shelosha. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: af al pi sheen gavoah shelosha.
May tama: la mishtammesh leh.
Rav ashe amar: afillu sheggavoah shelosha, may tama: efshar detale beh midde.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: milleo kullo bitedot mahu?
Amar leh: la shemia lach ha deamar rabbi yochanan: bor vechuleyaytah mitztaref laasara.
Veammay, ha la mishtammesh leh? ella may it lach lememar — demannach midde umishtammesh, hacha name demannach midde umishtammesh.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kotel asara — tzarich sullam arbaa asar lehattiro. rav yosef amar: afillu shelosha asar umashshehu.
Abbaye amar: afillu achad asar umashshehu.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: afillu shiva umashshehu.
Amar rav: sullam zakuf — memaet. gemara, vela yadana may tama.
Amar shemuel: vela yada abba tama deha milleta?! midde dehave aitzteva al gabbe itzteva.
Amar rabba amar rabbi chiyyay: dekalim shebbevavel — enan tzerichin keva. may tama: kevedan kovatan.
Verav yosef amar rabbi oshaya: sullamot shebbevavel — enan tzerichin keva. may tama: kevedan kovatan.
Man deamar sullamot, kol shekken dekalim. uman deamar dekalim, aval sullamot la.
Bea minneh rav yosef merabba: sullam mikkan vesullam mikkan vekashshin baemtza, mahu?
Amar leh: en kaf haregel ola bahen.
Kashshin mikkan vekashshin mikkan vesullam baemtza, mahu? amar leh: hare kaf haregel ola bahen.
b: Chakak lehashelim bakkotel, bechamma? amar leh: baasara.
Amar leh: chakako kullo bakkotel, bechamma? amar leh: melo komato. umay shena? amar leh: hatam mistallek leh, hacha la mistallek leh.
Bea minneh rav yosef merabba: asao lailan sullam, mahu?
Tibbee lerabbi, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi: ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam kol davar shehu mishshum shevut lo gazru alav — hane mille ben hashshemashot, aval kulle yoma — la.
O dilma afillu lerabbanan: pitcha hu, vearya hu dirvia aleh.
Asao laashera sullam, mahu? tibbee lerabbi yehuda, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi yehuda: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam demuttar liknot bayit beissure hanaa, ella hatam, devatar dikna leh eruv la nicha leh delinnetar.
O dilma afillu lerabbanan: pitcha hu, vearya dirvia aleh.
Amar leh: ilan muttar, vaashera asura. matkef la rav chisda: adderabba, ilan sheissur shabbat gorem lo — nittesar.
Ashera sheissur davar acher gorem lo — la nittesar.
Ittemar name, ki ata ravin, amar rabbi elazar, veamri la amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheissur shabbat garam lo — asur, kol sheissur davar acher garam lo — muttar.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: ilan — pelugeta derabbi verabbanan. ashera — pelugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan.
Mishna charitz shebben shete chatzerot, amok asara verochav arbaa — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad. afillu male kash o teven. male afar o tzerorot — mearvin echad, veen mearvin shenayim.
Natan alav neser sherachav arbaa tefachim, vechen shete gezuzetraot zo keneged zo — mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu mearvin echad. pachot mikkan — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad.
Gemara veteven la chayetz? veha anan tenan: matben shebben shete chatzerot gavoah asara tefachim — mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad!
Amar abbaye: leinyan mechitza — kulle alma la peligi dehavya mechitza, aval leinyan chatzitza, i batteleh — chayetz, vei la batteleh — la chayetz.
Male afar. vaafillu bistama? vehatnan: bayit shemmilleahu teven o tzerorot uvittelo — batel.
Bittelo — in,

a: Lo bittelo — la. amar rav huna: man tana ohalot — rabbi yose hi.
I rabbi yose ippecha shaminan leh. detanya, rabbi yose omer: teven veen atid lefannoto — hare hu kistam afar, uvatel. afar veatid lefannoto — hare hu kistam teven, velo batel.
Ella amar rav assi: man tena eruvin — rabbi yose hi.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: tumea ashshabbat karamet?! hannach issur shabbat, daafillu arneki name mevattel inish.
Rav ashe amar: bayit acharitz ka ramet?! bishlama charitz lemityeymeh kae. ella bayit, lemityeymeh kae?
Natan alav neser sherochav arbaa. amar rava: lo shanu ella shennatan lerochbo, aval leorko — afillu kol shehu name, shehare miato mearbaa.

Vechen shete gezuzetraot zo keneged zo. amar rava: ha deamrat zo keneged zo — in, zo shello keneged zo — lo, vezo lemala mizzo name, la amaran ella sheyyesh ben ze laze shelosha tefachim, aval en ben ze laze shelosha — gezuzetra akumma hi.

Mishna matben shebben shete chatzerot gavoah asara tefachim — mearvin shenayim, veen mearvin echad. ellu maachilin mikkan, veellu maachilin mikkan. nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim, — mearvin echad, veen mearvin shenayim.
Gemara amar rav huna: uvilvad shello yitten letoch kuppato veyaachil.
Uleokome shere? vehaamar rav huna amar rabbi chanina: maamid adam et behemto al gabbe asavim beshabbat. veen maamid adam et behemto al gabbe muketze beshabbat.
Dekaem la beappa veazla veachla.

Velo yitten letoch kuppato teven? vehatanya: bayit shebben shete chatzerot umilleahu teven — mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad. ze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil, veze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil. nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim — shenehem asurim.
Ketzad hu ose? noel et beto umevattel et reshuto, hu asur vachavero muttar.
Vechen atta omer begov shel teven shebben shene techume shabbat. katane mihat: ze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil, veze noten letoch kuppato veyaachil.
Amri: bayit, kevan deikka (mechitztzot v)tikra, ki mippechit — minnachra leh milleta. hacha — la minnachra leh milleta.
Nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim shenehen asurin. ha asara — shere, veaf al gav demiddalya tikra tuva. shema minna: mechitztzot sheen maggiot lattikra — sheman mechitztzot.
Amar abbaye: hacha bevayit shelosha asar chaser mashshehu askinan, veteven asara.
Verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: afillu tema bevet asara
b: Veteven shiva umashshehu, dechol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame.
Bishlama leabbaye, hayeynu dekatane "measara", ella lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua may "measara"?
Mittorat asara.
Shenehen asurin. shema minna dayorin habbain beshabbat asurin?
Dilma deimmeat meetmol.
Ketzad hu ose? noel et beto umevattel reshuto. tarte?! hachi kaamar: o noel et beto o mevattel et reshuto.
Veibbaet ema: leolam tarte, kevan dedash beh — ate letaltole.
Hu asur vachavero muttar. peshita? la tzericha, dahadar iddach uvattel leh lechavreh, veha ka mashma lan: deen mevattelin vechozrin umevattelin.
Vechen atta omer begov shel teven shebben shene techume shabbat. peshita! la tzericha lerabbi akiva deamar: techumin deorayyta, mahu detema: ligzor dilma ate leichallofe, ka mashma lan.
Mishna ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy? manniach et hechavit, veomer: hare zo lechol bene mavoy, umezakke lahen al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim, veal yede ishto.
Aval eno mezakke lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim, velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado.
Gemara amar rav yehuda: chavit shel shittufe mevoot tzarich lehagebiah min hakkarka tefach.
Amar rava: hane tarte mille, save defumebdita amrinhu: chada — ha. iddach — hamekaddesh, im taam melo lugemav — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza.
Amar rav chaviva: ha name save defumebdita amrinhu, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: osin medura lachayya beshabbat.
Sevur minna: lechayya — in, lechole — la. bimot haggeshamim — in, bimot hachamma — la.
Ittemar, amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: hikkiz dam venitztannen — osin lo medura beshabbat, vaafillu bitkufat tammuz.
Amar ammemar: ha name save defumebdita amrinhu, deittemar: ezo hi ashera setam?
Amar rav: kol shekkomarin shomrin otah

a: Veen toamin mipperoteha.
Ushemuel amar: kegon deamri "hane tamre leshichra deve nitzrefe deshatu leh beyom chaggam". (amar ammemar:) vaamaru li save defumebdita: hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel.
Metivi: ketzad mishtattefin bemavoy — meviim chavit shel yayin veshel shemen veshel temarim veshel gerogrot veshel shear mine perot.
Im mishshello — tzarich lezakkot. veim mishshellahen — tzarich lehodia. umagbiah min hakkarka mashshehu! may "mashshehu" name dekaamar? tefach.
Ittemar: shittufe mevoot, rav amar: en tzarich lezakkot, ushemuel amar: tzarich lezakkot. eruve techumin, rav amar: tzarich lezakkot, ushemuel amar: en tzarich lezakkot.
Bishlama lishmuel — hacha tenan, vehacha la tenan. ella lerav may tama?
Tannae hi, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: maase bechallato shel rabbi oshaya shehalcha levet hammerchatz, vechashcha lah, veerva lah chamotah.
Uva maase lifne rabbi chiyyay — veasar. amar lo rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: bavlay, kol kach atta machmir beeruvin?! kach amar abba: kol sheyyesh lecha lehakel beeruvin — hakel.
Veibbaya lehu: mishshel chamotah erva lah, umishshum delo zikketa lah. o dilma: mishshellah erva lah, umishshum deshello middatah?
Amar lahen hahu merabbanan, verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha la minneh derabbi yochanan — mishshel chamotah erva, umishshum delo zikketa lah.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov (bereh) devat yaakov: ki matet hatam, akkef vezil lesullama detzor, uvaya minneh merav yaakov bar idi.
Bea minneh: mishshel chamotah erva, umishshum delo zikketa lah, o dilma: mishshellah erva, umishshum deshello middatah?
Amar leh: mishshel chamotah erva lah, umishshum delo zikketa lah.
Amar rav nachman: naktinan, echad eruve techumin, veechad eruve chatzerot, echad shittufe mevoot tzarich lezakkot. bae rav nachman: eruve tavshilin tzarich lezakkot, o en tzarich lezakkot?

Amar rav yosef: umay tibbee leh? la shemia leh ha deamar rav nachman bar rav adda amar shemuel: eruve tavshilin tzarich lezakkot. amar leh abbaye: peshita dela shemia leh. dei shemia leh, may tibbee leh?
Amar leh: attu eruve techumin mi la amar shemuel: en tzarich lezakkot, veamar ihu: tzarich lezakkot.
Hachi hasheta?! bishlama hatam peligi rav ushemuel, veka mashma lan kechumerin demar vechi chumerin demar, aval hacha, i ita dishmia leh mi ikka deman diflig?
Hahu turezina dahava beshivavuteh derabbi zera, amaru leh: ogayr lan reshutach, la ogayr lehu. ato lekammeh derabbi zera amaru leh: mahu, lemegar middevethu?
Amar lehu: hachi amar resh lakish mishshemeh degavra rabba, umannu rabbi chanina: ishto shel adam mearevet shello middato.

Hahu turezina dahava beshivavuteh derav yehuda bar oshaya, amri leh: ogar lan reshutach, la ogar lehu. ato lekammeh derav yehuda bar oshaya, amri leh: mahu lemegar middevethu, la hava bideh. ato lekammeh derav matna, la hava bideh. ato lekammeh derav yehuda, amar lehu: hachi amar shemuel: ishto shel adam mearevet shello middato.
Metivi: nashim sheervu venishtattefu shello middaat baalehen, en eruvan eruv, veen shittufan shittuf!
La kashya: ha — deasar, ha — dela asar.

Hachi name mistabbera, deim ken kashya dishmuel addishmuel, deamar shemuel: echad mibbene mavoy sheragil lehishtattef im bene mavoy, velo nishtattef — bene hammavoy nichnasin letoch beto venotlin shittufan mimmennu beal korcho.
Ragil in, sheen ragil la. shema minna.
Lema mesayyay leh: kofin oto laasot lechi vekora lammavoy.
b: Shane hatam delekka mechitzot.
Lishshana acharina, metzad shane.
Ittemar, rav chiyyay bar ashe amar: osin lechi ashera. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: osin kora ashera.
Man deamar kora — kol shekken lechi, uman deamar lechi — aval kora la. kattote mechattat shiureh.
Mishna nitmaet haochel — mosif umezakke, veen tzarich lehodia. nittosfu alehen — mosif umezakke, vetzarich lehodia.
Kamma hu shiuran? bizman shehen merubbin — mezon shete seudot lechullam. bizman shehen muatin — kigrogeret lechol echad veechad.
Amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim — bitchillat eruv, aval bishyare eruv — kol shehu.
Velo amru learev bachatzerot ella kede shello leshakkeach et hattinokot.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema bemin echad, may irya nitmaet? afillu kala name!
Ella bishne minin, afillu nitmaet name la! detanya: kala haochel, mimmin echad — en tzarich lehodia, mishshene minim — tzarich lehodia!
Ibbaet ema: mimmin echad, veibbaet ema: mishshene minin. ibbaet ema: mimmin echad, may nitmaet — nitmatmet.
Veibbaet ema: mishshene minin, kala shane.
Nittosfu alehen mosif umezakke vechulei. amar rav shezvi amar rav chisda: zot omeret chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi yehuda.
Ditnan: amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — beeruve techumin, aval beeruve chatzerot — mearvin ben ledaat uven shello ledaat. peshita dachalukin!
Mahu detema: hane mille bechatzer shebben shene mevoot, aval chatzer shel mavoy echad, ema la. kamashma lan.
Kamma hu shiuro vechulei. kamma hu merubbin? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shemone esre bene adam. shemone esre, vetu la: ema mishshemone esre veelach.

Umay shemone esre denaket? amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: ledidi mipparsha li minneh deabba: kol sheillu mechalleko limzon shete seudot benehen veen maggaat gerogeret lechol echad veechad — hen hen merubbin, vesaggi bimzon shete seudot. vei la — (hen hen) muatin ninhu.
Veaggav orcheh ka mashma lan dishte seudot havyayn shemone esre gerogrot.

Mishna bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: kikkar hu eruv, afillu maafe sea, vehu perusa — en mearvin bah. kikkar keissar vehu shalem — mearvin bo.

a: Gemara tenena chada zimna: bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim vehammelach!
Amar rabba: leappoke midderabbi yehoshua, deamar: kikkar — in, midde acharina — la, kamashma lan "bakkol".

Etiveh abbaye: bakkol mearvin eruve chatzerot uvakkol mishtattefin shittufe mevoot, velo amru learev befat ella bechatzer bilvad. man shamat leh deamar pat — in, midde acharina — la, rabbi yehoshua, vekatane "bakkol"!
Ella amar rabba bar bar chana: leappoke midderabbi yehoshua, deamar shelema — in, perusa — la, kamashma lan "bakkol".
Uferusa may tama la? amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi: mishshum eva.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ervu kullan bifrusot mahu? amar leh: shemma yachzor davar lekilkulo.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben shaul: nittela hemenna kede challatah uchede dimmuah — mearvin lo bah.
Vehatanya: kede dimmuah — mearvin lo bah, kede challatah — en mearvin lo bah!
La kashya: ha — bechallat nachtom, ha — bechallat baal habbayit.

Ditnan: shiur challa echad meesrim vearbaa. haose issa leatzmo veissa lemishte veno, echad meesrim vearbaa. nachtom shehu ose limkor bashshuk, vechen haishsha sheashta limkor bashshuk — echad mearbaim ushemona.
Amar rav chisda: tefarah bekesam mearvin lo bah. veha tanya en mearvin lo bah! la kashya, ha — didia tifrah, ha — dela yedia tifrah.
Amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: mearvin befat orez uvefat dochan. amar mar ukeva: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel, befat orez — mearvin, uvefat dochan — en mearvin.
Amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav: mearvin befat adashim. ini?! veha hahi dahavay bishne demar shemuel, veshadyay lechalbeh vela achla!
Hahi dishar minim havya, dichtiv: "veatta kach lecha chittin useorim ufol vaadashim vedochan vechussemim vegomer".
Rav pappa amar: hahi tzeluya betzoat haadam havay, dichtiv: "vehi begelle tzeat haadam teugena leenehem".
