May "veugat seorim tochlenna"? amar rav chisda: leshiurim. rav pappa amar: arivatah kaarivat seorim, velo kaarivat chittim.
Mishna noten adam maa lachenvani velannachtom kede sheyyezakke lo eruv, divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim: lo zachu lo meotav.
b: Umodim bishar kol haadam, shezzachu lo meotav. sheen mearvin laadam ella middato.
Amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim beeruve techumin, aval beeruve chatzerot — mearvin ledato veshello ledato, lefi shezzachin laadam shello befanav, veen chavin laadam shello befanav.
Gemara may tama derabbi eliezer? ha lo mashach!

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avahu: asao rabbi eliezer kearbaa perakim bashshana, ditnan: bearbaa perakim ellu mashchitin et hattabbach beal korcho. afillu shor shave elef dinar veen lallokeach ella dinar echad — kofin oto lishchot.
Lefichach im met, met lallokeach. met lallokeach? ha lo mashach! amar rav huna: beshemmashach.
I hachi, ema sefa: bishar yemot hashshana eno ken. lefichach im met, met lammocher. ammay? ha mashach!
Amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: leolam beshello mashach, hacha bemay askinan beshezzikka lo al yede acher.
Bearbaa perakim ellu dizchut hu lo — zachin lo shello befanav. bishar yemot hashshana, dechov hu lo — en chavin lo ella befanav.
Verav ila amar rabbi yochanan: bearbaa perakim ellu heemidu chachamim divrehen al divre tora. deamar rabbi yochanan: devar tora, maot konot.
Umippene ma amru meshicha kona — gezera shemma yomar lo: nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay.
Umodim bishar kol haadam kulei. man shear kol adam? amar rav: baal habbayit.
Vechen amar shemuel: baal habbayit. deamar shemuel: lo shanu ella nachtom, aval baal habbayit — kone. veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella maa, aval keli — kone.
Veamar shemuel: lo shanu ella deamar lo "zeche li", aval amar "arev li", shaliach shavveye, vekane.
Amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda, velo od ella kol makom sheshshana rabbi yehuda beeruvin halacha kemoto.
Amar leh rav chana bagdataa lerav yehuda: amar shemuel afillu bemavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav?
Amar leh: beeruvin amarti lecha, velo bimchitzot.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: "halacha", mikkelal difligi. vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda "ematay" uvamme" bemishnatenu — eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim!
Vela peligi? veha anan tenan: nittosfu alehen — mosif umezakke, vetzarich lehodia!
Hatam bechatzer shebben shene mevoot.
Vehaamar rav shezvi amar rav chisda: zot omeret chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi yehuda.
Ella:

a: Gavra aggavra ka ramet?! mar savar peligi, umar savar la peligi.
Gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda "ematay" uvamme" bemishnatenu — eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim. verabbi yochanan amar: "ematay" lefaresh, uvamme" lachalok.
Veematay" lefaresh hu? veha tenan: veellu hen happesulim: hamesachek bekuveya, umalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit.
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman sheen lo ummanut ella hi, aval yesh lo ummanut shello hi — hare ze kasher.
Vetane ala bevarayyta, vachachamim omrim: ben sheen lo ummanut ella hi, uven sheyyesh lo ummanut shello hi — hare ze pasul.
Hahi derabbi yehuda amar rabbi tarfon hi.
Detanya, amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon: leolam en echad mehen nazir, lefi sheen nezirut ella lehafelaa.
Alma kevan dimsappeka leh i nazir i la nazir hu — la meshabed nafsheh. hacha name: kevan dela yada i kane i la kane — la gamar umakne.
Haderan alach challon

Mishna ketzad mishtattefin bitchumin? manniach et hechavit, veomer: hare ze lechol bene iri, lechol mi sheyyelech levet haevel o levet hammishte. vechol shekkibbel alav mibbeod yom — muttar, mishshettechshach — asur. sheen mearvin mishshettechshach.
Gemara amar rav yosef: en mearvin ella lidvar mitzva. may ka mashma lan? tenena: lechol mi sheyyelech levet haevel o levet hammishte!
Mahu detema: orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan.
Vechol shekkibbel alav mibbeod yom. shamat minna en berera, dei yesh berera — tiggalle milleta lemafrea demibbeod yom hava nicha leh!
Amar rav ashe: "hodiuhu" velo hodiuhu" katane.
Amar rav assi: katan ben shesh yotze beeruv immo. metivi: katan shetztzarich leimmo — yotze beeruv immo, vesheen tzarich leimmo — en yotze beeruv immo.
Utenan name gabbe sukka ki hay gavvna: katan sheen tzarich leimmo — chayyayv besukka.
Vehavenan ba: veezehu katan sheen tzarich leimmo? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol shennifne veen immo mekannachto.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: kol shenneor veeno kore "imma". "imma" salka datach? gedolim, name karu. ella ema: kol shenneor mishshenato veeno kore "imma, imma".
Vechamma? kevar arba, kevar chamesh.
b: Amar rav yehoshua bereh derav idi: ki kaamar rav assi — kegon sheerav alav aviv latztzafon veimmo laddarom, daafillu bar shesh name betzavvta deimmeh nicha leh.
Metivi: katan shetztzarich leimmo yotze beeruv immo — ad ben shesh. teyuveta derav yehoshua bar rav idi teyuveta.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derav assi! amar lecha rav assi: "ad", vead bakkelal.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derabbi yannay veresh lakish! la kashya, ha — deiteh avuhi bemata, ha — dela iteh avuhi bemata.

Tanu rabbanan: mearev adam al yede beno uvitto hakketannim, al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, ben ledatan ben shello ledatan. aval eno mearev lo al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim, [velo] al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, velo al yede ishto ella middatam.

Tanya iddach: lo yearev adam al yede beno uvitto haggedolim, veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim, velo al yede ishto ella middatan. aval mearev hu al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, veal yede beno uvitto hakketannim, ben ledatan uven shello ledatan — mippene sheyyadan keyado.
Vechullan sheervu veerav alehem rabban — yotzin beshel rabban, chutz min haishsha, mippene sheyyechola limchot.
Ishsha may shena? amar rabba: ishsha vechol dedame la.
Amar mar: chutz min haishsha, mippene sheyyechola limchot. tama demachay, ha setama — nafka bidvala. ha katane resha "ella middatam". may lav, deamri: "in"!
La: may "ella middatam" — deishtiku. leappoke hecha deamri: "la".
Ha: vechullan sheervu veerav alehen rabban — yotzin beshel rabban, usetama hu, vekatane: chutz min haishsha dela nafki!
Amar rava: kevan sheervu, en lecha michuy gadol mizze.
Mishna kamma hu shiuro? mezon shete seudot lechol echad veechad. mezono lachol velo lashshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: lashshabbat velo lachol, veze vaze mitkavvevnim lehakel.
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: mikkikkar befunedyon, mearba sein besela. rabbi shimon omer: shete yadot lakkikkar mishshalosh lakkav.
Chetzyay, labbayit hamenugga. vachatzi chetzyay, lifsol et haggeviyyay.
Gemara vechamma mezon shete seudot? amar rav yehuda amar rav: tarte rifata ikkaryayta. rav adda bar ahava amar: tarte rifata nehar pappayata.
Amar leh rav yosef lerav yosef bereh derava: avuch keman sevira leh? kerabbi meir sevira leh. ana name kerabbi meir sevira leh. dei kerabbi yehuda, kashya ha deamri inashe: ravvcha livsima shechiach.
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer. tana: ukerovim divrehen lihyot shavin. mi dame?! derabbi yochanan arba seodata lekabba, derabbi shimon tesha seodata lekabba!
Amar rav chisda: tze mehen shelish lachenvani.
Veakkatti lemar tisha. ulemar shet!
[Ella keiddach] derav chisda, deamar: tze mehen mechetza lachenvani.
Veakkatti: lemar tesha, ulemar tamne! — hayeynu dekaamar "ukerovim divrehem lihyot shavin".
Kashya derav chisda adderav chisda! la kashya, ha — deka yahev baal habbayit tzive. ha — dela yahev baal habbayit tzive.
Chetzyay labbayit hamenugga, vachatzi chetzyay lifsol et haggeviyyay.
